messages:
Rae: Heads-up: starting a limited rollout of time-sliced reservations (TSR) for A100x in SFO (us-west-1) and AMS (eu-west-4) tomorrow 07:00 UTC. This is a policy + capacity change, not a new physical GPU. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Diego: Time-sliced? like fractional reservations?
Rae: Exactly. Customers can reserve 25%, 50%, or 75% time-slices on single A100x instances. The goal is better utilization and cheaper entry for smaller workloads.
Nina: Billing mechanics? prorated? any rounding gotchas?
Rae: Billing is per-minute prorated on committed hours. Example: 50% 1-month commit = 0.5x charge of a full GPU commitment. Burst usage outside slice billed at on-demand full-GPU rates. billing-bot: NOTE: Billing docs updated at /billing/tsr-pricing (internal). CSV export will show `tsr_fraction` column.
Owen: How will routing work? what about latency SLOs?
Rae: Requests routed normally; the serving layer enforces time windows per-slice. We reserve scheduling slots to meet soft-latency SLOs but recommend customers target <6ms token overhead tolerance. Fallbacks will hit other A100x pools or H200-compatible variants where allowed.
chris-op: Ops concerns: preemption behavior? metrics?
Rae: Preemption only occurs if a higher-priority full-GPU reservation needs capacity. We use gradual reclaiming with 30s grace + KV cache snapshotting. infra-bot: METRIC-HOOK: tsr-schedule-latency, tsr-preempt-count attached.
Diego: Are these available for Dedicated and Dedicated-Edge?
Rae: Initially Dedicated standard only. Edge and Private will follow after we validate scheduling stability.
Nina: Does SDK/console UI need changes?
Rae: Console will show a "Fraction" slider in the reservation flow. SDK: new field `reservation_fraction` (0.25/0.5/0.75). PRs are queued; expect SDK patch by EOD.
Owen: Any limits per-account?
Rae: Beta caps: max 8 fractional reservations per account per-region. We'll lift after 2-week bake.
Diego: Compatibility with GPU-exclusive features (e.g., multi-GPU sharding)?
Rae: Not supported. TSR reservations are single-device only and do not allow multi-GPU join or distributed KV across slices.
Nina: Should support teams notify customers?
Rae: Yes please. Prep a blurb: "Lower-cost fractional dedicated reservations for latency-sensitive workloads in SFO & AMS — beta". Sara on marketing will get the copy.
chris-op: What's the canary plan?
Rae: Canary 07:00 UTC starts with 3 accounts per region (low-traffic). 4h health window then open to beta signups. Follow-up sync in #eng-runtime at 08:30 UTC to review tsr-schedule-latency and preempt traces.
billing-bot: NOTE: Reservations API change: add query param `?fractional=true` for list endpoints. Backwards compatible.
infra-bot: DEPLOY: tsr-scheduler v1.0 will be deployed at 07:00 UTC. Monitoring: tsr-health, tsr-preempt-trace attached.
Diego: TL;DR for internal: "Time-sliced reservations for A100x in SFO & AMS tomorrow 07:00 UTC. 25/50/75% slices, prorated billing, single-node only, beta caps=8, 4h canary."
Rae: Thanks all. Please escalate regressions to #incidents immediately. We'll publish full docs after canary clears.
